_why: Researched cal lines with road/gate/closure clauses removed by hand (owner note 2026-10-28: road text lives in GETTING THERE, not Trip plan). Everything else in each line is the researcher's.
wa_mount_baker_coleman_ski_descent: A spring ski objective (roughly April-June) when the Coleman-Deming holds continuous snow to camp. Usually 2 days with a camp near 6,000 ft at the Hogsback, though strong parties do it in a single day.
wa_ruby_mountain_happy_creek: A winter and spring ski or snowshoe route (roughly December-April); check the avalanche forecast, since the upper north bowls are avalanche terrain. Always a single day.
wa_ruby_mountain_northwest_ridge: A winter and spring snow scramble (roughly December-May); snow usually starts near 4,000 ft. Done car-to-car in a day.
wa_trapper_mountain_north_couloir: A spring ski/snow objective (roughly January to June, most often April to June). Normally done as one long car-to-car day; an overnight at Pelton Basin or Trapper Lake needs an NPS wilderness permit.
wa_mount_ballard_east_face: Best July to October once the upper east ridge is mostly melted out; early-season parties should expect steep snow near the col and carry crampons. Usually a single day; a spring trip in deep snow becomes two days with a bivy at the South Fork bridge.
wa_mount_price_south_ridge: Summer through fall. Snow ascents are possible but slow. It's the most direct line on the peak and a day trip from the car.
